howToPlay: Use the Super to close the distance to enemies and stun them for a quick takedown. Utilize the X-Ray-Shades gadget to scout bushes and ensure the path is clear before engaging. Use the Reserve Buoy gadget to quickly charge the Super if you need an immediate escape or engagement tool.
gears: SPEED and DAMAGE are ideal for an assassin to maximize mobility in bushes and combat effectiveness. VISION is also a great choice for keeping track of enemies.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive, fast-paced playstyles that rely on positioning and crowd control to eliminate targets.
